key_highlights: ASX set to advance on tech-led rally following Wall Street surge; oil snaps losing run (37, 28)
Aussie flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic demand (12)
Myer posts $276m annual loss on weak consumer spending; Solly Lew joins board (26, 28)
RBA rate hikes continue to squeeze household spending, pressuring consumer discretionary (31)
Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) send Australian fuel prices surging; shortage expected into 2027 (40, 58)
Gold miners active: Platina banks Rio cheque for WA push, Dalaroo advances Côte d'Ivoire and Greenland rare earths, Broken Hill lifts SA resource (39, 41, 77, 78)
Jetstar staff industrial action escalates with waived baggage/seat fees (33, 36)
China rebalancing towards robotics; Xi under fire amid domestic cracks (52, 73)
Federal/state governments face debt cliff; Intergenerational Report locks in mass migration (51, 60)

sectors.trend: Gold and rare earths names active; Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill advancing exploration. Oil snaps losing run on tech rally but diesel shortage supports energy complex. China robot rebalancing may pressure iron ore/coal demand medium-term.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (PLA.AX, DAR.AX, BHP.AX gold exposure) benefit from safe-haven flows. Rare earths (DAR.AX Greenland) gain strategic premium. Monitor iron ore (RIO.AX, BHP.AX, FMG.AX) for China demand shift.

sectors.trend: Myer $276m loss on weak spending; RBA rate hikes squeezing households. Pain trade roars as fuel prices surge. Jetstar industrial action adds cost pressure.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary (MYR.AX, WES.AX, WBC.AX) under pressure. Fuel-cost inflation erodes real incomes. Jetstar (JLH.AX) faces operational disruption from union action.

sectors.trend: Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) push Australian fuel prices higher. Energy prices dumped on US Democrat sweep hopes. Diesel shortage expected into 2027.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from elevated oil/diesel prices. Transport and logistics face margin compression. Trump diesel intervention adds policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Tech stocks lead ASX higher post Wall Street surge. Data centres strain net-zero targets. China pivots to robotics.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefits from global risk-on. Data centre power demand supports energy infrastructure. China robot theme may lift ASX industrials.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes continue; household stress rising. Government debt cliff pressures sovereign credit. Migration policy uncertainty affects housing demand.
sectors.implications: Big 4 (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) benefit from higher rates but face credit risk from squeezed borrowers. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by elevated borrowing costs.

sectors.trend: Record sheep prices; farmers pivot to renewables. El Niño 'Godzilla' threatens agriculture. Pain trade roars.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX stable. Agricultural names (GRL.AX, SPL.AX) face El Niño risk but benefit from record livestock prices. Renewable energy adoption by farmers supports clean-energy equities.

key_themes: RBA rate hike cycle squeezing consumer spending and housing
Global diesel/oil supply shock (Iran, Ukraine, Saudi) driving fuel inflation
Gold and rare earths exploration momentum in WA and SA
China structural rebalancing towards robotics, potential demand shift for commodities
Government debt sustainability concerns (federal and state)
Industrial action risk (Jetstar, Virgin) in transport sector
Migration policy and Intergenerational Report fiscal implications

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price inflation from global diesel shortage
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport/logistics exposure; favour energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX); monitor Arafura and Codelco diesel supply chains

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hikes eroding household spending and credit quality
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce consumer discretionary exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives; monitor NIMV and arrears data
Diversify away from pure iron ore/coal exposure; favour gold and rare earths; monitor China PMI and robot investment data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Government debt cliff and fiscal sustainability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor Intergenerational Report updates; favour quality financials with strong capital buffers; avoid high-yield sovereign-linked credit
Avoid JLH.AX and VIR.AX near-term; monitor union negotiations and service disruption
Monitor BOM forecasts; favour diversified agribusiness (GRL.AX) over single-crop exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths miners
opportunities.rationale: Active exploration (Platina WA, Dalaroo Côte d'Ivoire/Greenland, Broken Hill SA) plus safe-haven demand amid geopolitical oil shock and China uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on diesel/oil supply shock
opportunities.rationale: Global diesel shortage into 2027 supports pricing; Saudi oil shock lifts Australian fuel prices; energy names benefit from structural tightness

opportunities.recommendation: Selective tech exposure on global risk-on
opportunities.rationale: Tech leads ASX post Wall Street surge; data centre demand and China robot pivot support secular growth

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and retail exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Myer $276m loss, RBA rate squeeze, fuel inflation eroding real incomes; pain trade roars

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid transport/aviation names amid industrial action
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar and Virgin union disputes create operational and earnings uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk in REITs and housing-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated RBA rates and government debt cliff pressure valuations; migration policy uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to grind higher on tech momentum and oil recovery, but PMI softness, Myer loss, and fuel inflation cap upside. Expect range-bound ^AXJO with sector rotation into energy and gold. Jetstar/Virgin industrial action adds volatility to transport.
market_outlook.long_term: RBA rate cycle peak and potential easing support financials and REITs recovery. China robot rebalancing may structurally shift commodity demand. Government debt trajectory and migration policy will be key fiscal overhangs. Gold/rare earths theme gains strategic relevance. El Niño adds agricultural volatility.

Australian flash PMI follow-through and NAB/MES business conditions
Global diesel/oil supply resolution (Iran, Ukraine, Saudi)
China robot investment data and iron ore demand signals
Intergenerational Report and migration policy updates
Myer half-year guidance and consumer spending data
watch_list: Iron ore, gold, LNG, coal prices
RBA cash rate and mortgage arrears data
China PMI and robot capex data
El Niño intensity and agricultural output forecasts
